review.note: Retracted in M22: the election of 10 October 1999, at which the Socialists were returned one seat short of an absolute majority. The atlas can argue nothing from it: the euro was joined nine months before it, Macau was handed over under terms fixed in 1987, and the government it produced resigned in December 2001 after a local election the atlas does not hold. Revisit with the resignation of 2001, which is the missing record.
